description:
Save a screener filter query for scheduled enter/exit (joiner/leaver) notifies.

    Same rows as Terminal Save on /screener. Pass last_symbols (current matches)
    or call run_screener after create to seed the baseline; later runs notify
    names that enter or leave when Settings Screener in & out is on.

    Args:
        name: Screener name (blank → derived from filters)
        query: Filter blob {universe, fmp, metrics, ai, member?, view?}
        schedule: "off", "daily", or "weekly" (weekly requires Pro)
        notify_on_change: Notify on enter/exit after the first seed (default true)
        last_symbols: Current result tickers to seed the enter/exit baseline
name: create_screener
title: Create screener
